Haldi helps fight acne, reduce blemishes, and promote clear, radiant skin.
Chandan soothes the skin, evens out tone, and adds a cooling effect that refreshes and revitalizes.
This mild, foaming face wash is suitable for all skin types and ideal for daily use. Discover brighter, healthier, and naturally glowing skin with every wash!
